title: La deuda crece
goal: Explain why several Latin American governments accumulated substantial external debt during the 1970s.

items: Explain why several Latin American governments accumulated substantial external debt during the 1970s.
Use vocabulary for debt, loans and creditors.
Connect borrowing with changing international conditions.
Distinguish a loan from the debt created by it.
Use formal connectors such as «a raíz de» and «a lo largo de».
